items.name: kinetik-tokens
items.title: Kinetik Tokens
items.description: Colour, spacing, radius, type and shadow tokens with dark and light palettes, plus the optional KinetikProvider.

items.name: kinetik-motion
items.title: Kinetik Motion
items.description: The shared motion vocabulary: three springs, three durations, easings and the useReduceMotion hook.

items.name: kinetik-haptics
items.title: Kinetik Haptics
items.description: useHaptic: a small, meaningful haptic vocabulary that respects the provider switch.

items.name: kinetik-tilt
items.title: Kinetik Tilt
items.description: useTilt and TiltSensor: device tilt as shared values, read on the UI thread.

items.name: kinetik-clock
items.title: Kinetik Clock
items.description: useShaderClock: a pausable shader clock advanced on the UI thread, at 60 or 30 fps.

items.name: kinetik-count
items.title: Kinetik Count
items.description: useCountUp: a number that counts towards its target with an ease-out curve, for figures shown as text.

items.name: kinetik-shaders
items.title: Kinetik Shaders
items.description: Shared SkSL noise functions, lazily compiled runtime effects and colour uniforms.

items.name: activity-rings
items.title: Activity Rings
items.description: Concentric progress rings that wind up one after another; a ring past its goal laps itself.

perf.budget: Ring paths are built once per size; the wind-up trims them with one shared value per ring, drawn by a single Skia canvas.

a11y.reducedMotion: Rings appear filled to their values and selection fades without delay.
a11y.screenReader: The rings read as an image listing every ring's value, goal and share; legend rows are buttons with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Legend rows are at least 44 pt tall and span the legend's width.

items.name: aperture-card
items.title: Aperture Card
items.description: A card closed by a camera-like iris whose blades turn open to reveal the content.

perf.budget: While opening or closing, two small paths (blades and seams) are rebuilt on the UI thread each frame; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The blades fade out instead of turning.
a11y.screenReader: Button role with expanded state; the hidden content is not exposed until the card is open.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole card (at least 200 pt tall).

items.name: aurora-veil
items.title: Aurora Veil
items.description: A slow, flowing aurora drawn by a fragment shader, for screen and hero backgrounds.

perf.budget: One full-surface fragment shader (4-octave fbm, twice) per frame. frameRate={30} halves the work; reduceEffects draws a single frame.

measurements.notes: Animates by design while active; pass active={false} off-screen. Clock drops to 30 fps with reduceEffects.

a11y.reducedMotion: A single still frame of the aurora; no per-frame work.
a11y.screenReader: Decorative: the canvas is hidden from assistive tech. Children stay accessible.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Bars that spring up in a wave; drag across them and the one under the finger stays bright with its value.

perf.budget: One spring per bar when values change and one opacity timing per bar when the selection changes, all on the UI thread.

a11y.reducedMotion: Bars reach their height with a short timing instead of the wave of springs.
a11y.screenReader: Adjustable: swipe up and down to move between bars; each reads its label and value.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole chart is the scrub area; each bar's column is a target.

items.name: beam-button
items.title: Beam Button
items.description: A button with a beam of light running around its edge, leaving a soft glow that brightens on press.

perf.budget: One small Skia canvas; a frame callback advances the beam's angle on the UI thread. It stops while disabled or with reduced motion.

a11y.reducedMotion: The beam holds still at the top left; the press still gives a 1% press-in.
a11y.screenReader: Button role with disabled state; 'activate' presses it.
a11y.touchTarget: 52 pt tall and at least 104 pt wide.

items.name: bloom-menu
items.title: Bloom Menu
items.description: A floating action button that blooms: the plus turns, a halo opens and actions spring out one by one.

perf.budget: One spring per action plus one for the button; views only, transforms and opacity. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Actions appear in place without travelling or staggering; the halo and the cross still change.
a11y.screenReader: The main button reports expanded; closed actions are hidden from screen readers. The escape gesture closes it.
a11y.touchTarget: 60 pt main button, 48 pt actions; in the column layout the label is part of the action's target.

items.name: confetti-burst
items.title: Confetti Burst
items.description: A burst of confetti drawn as one Skia Atlas, with physics on the UI thread.

perf.budget: All particles are one Atlas draw call. Physics runs in a frame callback only while particles are alive (about 3 s per burst), then stops.

a11y.reducedMotion: No particles; the success haptic still plays.
a11y.screenReader: Decorative: the canvas is hidden. Announce the event that triggered the burst in your own UI.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive; touches pass through to the content.

items.name: deckfall
items.title: Deckfall
items.description: A stack of cards swiped away one at a time, with the cards behind rising into place.

perf.budget: Only visible cards (plus one) are mounted. Dragging updates two shared values on the UI thread; each card evaluates one style worklet.

a11y.reducedMotion: No tilt or vertical drift; a swiped card fades out quickly instead of flying away.
a11y.screenReader: Only the top card is exposed, with 'swipe left' and 'swipe right' actions named by leftLabel/rightLabel. Other cards are hidden.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole top card.

items.name: dock-bar
items.title: Dock Bar
items.description: A floating bottom navigation bar whose items swell under the finger like a dock.

perf.budget: While touching, one shared value (finger position) drives one transform per item on the UI thread; React renders only when the hovered item changes.

a11y.reducedMotion: No magnification; items stay their rest size and the label bubble still shows.
a11y.screenReader: Tab list; each item is a tab with its label and selected state, and 'activate' chooses it.
a11y.touchTarget: Items are 48 pt square by default (minimum 40).

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: A ring of rounded slices that sweeps in; tap a slice to bring it forward and read its share in the middle.

perf.budget: Slice paths are built once per data change; the sweep and the selection are shared values read by one Skia canvas.

a11y.reducedMotion: The ring appears complete and selection changes without the bounce.
a11y.screenReader: The ring reads as an image with every slice and value; legend rows are buttons with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Legend rows are 44 pt tall and full width; the ring itself is also tappable.

items.name: drift-marquee
items.title: Drift Marquee
items.description: An endless row that drifts on its own; drag it to scrub, fling it, and the items lean into the speed.

perf.budget: A frame callback advances one offset on the UI thread; each item wraps around with a single transform. Pass active={false} off-screen to stop it.

a11y.reducedMotion: No drift and no lean. The row still scrolls by dragging.
a11y.screenReader: Each item is read once; the copies that fill the loop are hidden.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole row is the drag area.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: A slider that stretches like rubber past its ends and springs back, with a value bubble.

perf.budget: Dragging updates shared values on the UI thread; React re-renders only when the stepped value changes.

a11y.reducedMotion: No rubber-band stretch; the thumb still follows the finger and the value bubble appears without travel.
a11y.screenReader: Adjustable role with min, max, current value and formatted text; increment and decrement move by one step (at least 5% of the range).
a11y.touchTarget: At least 44 pt tall across the full width.

items.name: expand-card
items.title: Expand Card
items.description: A row that opens into a card: the thumbnail grows into a wide picture and the details rise in beneath it.

perf.budget: One spring drives the card height, picture size and title position on the UI thread; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Opens and closes in one step, without the morph.
a11y.screenReader: A button named by the title and subtitle with an expanded state; the body is hidden from screen readers while closed.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole row, at least 88 pt tall.

items.name: fan-stack
items.title: Fan Stack
items.description: A loose pile of pictures that fans out like a hand of cards; tap one to lift it out of the fan.

perf.budget: Three springs per card (fan, lift, dim), transforms and opacity only. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cards move straight to the fan or the pile without the stagger or the bounce.
a11y.screenReader: Gathered, the pile is one button ('Photos, 5 items'); fanned, every card is a button with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Cards are 148 by 192 pt by default; overlapping cards keep at least 60 pt of their width uncovered.

items.name: flip-ledger
items.title: Flip Ledger
items.description: A two-sided card that turns over in 3D, sized to the taller of its faces.

perf.budget: Idle: no per-frame work. Flipping: two transforms and two opacities for ~400 ms on the UI thread.

a11y.reducedMotion: Crossfades between faces instead of rotating; no lift.
a11y.screenReader: Button role with expanded state; only the visible face is exposed. 'Activate' flips the card.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole card is the target.

items.name: fold-panel
items.title: Fold Panel
items.description: A panel that unfolds in place: the body springs to its measured height and drifts in behind it.

perf.budget: One spring drives the height, the body, the chevron and the panel colour. The body is measured once per layout, not per frame.

a11y.reducedMotion: The body appears and disappears at once; the chevron flips without turning.
a11y.screenReader: The header is a button with an expanded state; a folded body is hidden from screen readers.
a11y.touchTarget: The header is at least 64 pt tall and full width.

items.name: gauge-meter
items.title: Gauge Meter
items.description: A dial that swings to its value on a spring while the figure counts up beneath it.

perf.budget: Arc and ticks are built once per size; the swing trims the arc and moves the knob from one shared value. The figure re-renders only while it counts.

a11y.reducedMotion: The arc and the figure show the value at once.
a11y.screenReader: A progress bar with its minimum, maximum and formatted value.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: glint-card
items.title: Glint Card
items.description: A card with a specular glint that slides with the finger or the tilt of the device.

perf.budget: Idle: no per-frame work. Moving: three gradients redrawn by Skia on the UI thread.

measurements.notes: Tilt changes below the visible threshold are ignored, so a phone at rest stops redrawing (was 113 frames per 5 s before). Heaviest interaction cost in the set: three gradients and a 3D transform per frame.

a11y.reducedMotion: Static reflection; tilt sensor and touch tracking are not started.
a11y.screenReader: Canvas is hidden from assistive tech; pass accessibilityLabel/Role to describe the card.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive by itself; any controls inside keep their own targets.

items.name: grain-drift
items.title: Grain Drift
items.description: A drifting four-colour mesh gradient under moving film grain, drawn by a shader.

perf.budget: One full-surface shader per frame: four distance weights, two noise lookups and one hash per pixel. frameRate={30} halves it.

measurements.notes: Animates by design while active; pass active={false} off-screen.

a11y.reducedMotion: A single still frame without drift or grain animation.
a11y.screenReader: Decorative: the canvas is hidden from assistive tech. Children stay accessible.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: heat-grid
items.title: Heat Grid
items.description: A calendar grid of days shaded by activity; the cells pop in as a wave and a drag reads any day.

perf.budget: Five paths, one per shade, rebuilt on the UI thread only during the intro wave; at rest the canvas is static.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cells appear at once, without the wave.
a11y.screenReader: An adjustable element: swipe up or down to step through days; the value reads the chosen day, or the total.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole grid; cells are chosen by dragging, so their small size does not matter.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: Press and hold to confirm: a ring fills around the icon and turns into a check mark.

perf.budget: One linear timing and three trimmed Skia paths while holding; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The progress ring and fill still advance (they carry information); the press scale is reduced to 1%.
a11y.screenReader: Button role. Double tap and hold ('longpress' action) confirms; a single double tap announces how to use it. Confirmation is announced.
a11y.touchTarget: 56 pt tall, at least 200 pt wide.

items.name: like-burst
items.title: Like Burst
items.description: A like button whose heart pops with a ring of light and a spray of sparks while the count rolls over.

perf.budget: One small Skia canvas: a ring, ten dots and the heart, all read from three shared values. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The heart fills without the pop, the ring or the sparks, and the count changes in place.
a11y.screenReader: A toggle button with a checked state; the count is its value.
a11y.touchTarget: The heart's box is 57 pt at the default size and the row is at least 44 pt tall.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A smooth line chart that draws itself in; drag across it and a guide, a dot and a label follow the finger.

perf.budget: The curve is built once per data change; drawing in, scrubbing and three pulses of the latest point are shared values read by one Skia canvas. Nothing is drawn at rest.

measurements.notes: Pulses three times after drawing in, then draws nothing at rest (0 frames in 5 s). It used to pulse forever.

a11y.reducedMotion: The line appears complete, without drawing in, and the latest point does not pulse.
a11y.screenReader: Adjustable: swipe up and down to step through the points; each reads its label and value.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole chart is the scrub area.

items.name: liquid-tabs
items.title: Liquid Tabs
items.description: A tab bar whose indicator flows like liquid, stretching, thinning and melting into place.

perf.budget: While switching, three springs drive one small blurred layer (body and droplet); nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The indicator slides without stretching, droplet or goo filter.
a11y.screenReader: Tab list with tabs that expose their selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Each tab spans its share of the bar and is 44 pt tall.

items.name: magnet-button
items.title: Magnet Button
items.description: A button that leans toward the finger from a field around it and presses on release.

perf.budget: Touch moves retarget two springs on the UI thread; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The button stays put and only dims slightly while the finger is over it.
a11y.screenReader: Button role; 'activate' presses it.
a11y.touchTarget: At least 52 pt tall; the field adds 40 pt of reach on every side.

items.name: marker-highlight
items.title: Marker Highlight
items.description: A paragraph where key phrases get marked as if with a highlighter, the ink sweeping in phrase by phrase.

perf.budget: One clock drives every stroke of ink on the UI thread; words are plain text views that wrap like a paragraph.

a11y.reducedMotion: Phrases appear already marked.
a11y.screenReader: Reads as one piece of text; the marking is visual only.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: morph-icon
items.title: Morph Icon
items.description: An icon button whose glyph reshapes between two states: menu to close, play to pause, plus to check.

perf.budget: One tiny Skia canvas. The glyph is rebuilt from a dozen points on the UI thread, and only while it morphs.

a11y.reducedMotion: The glyph switches without travelling or turning; the press still dips slightly.
a11y.screenReader: A toggle button with a checked state, or a button whose label swaps (Play / Pause) when activeAccessibilityLabel is set.
a11y.touchTarget: 48 pt by default; smaller sizes get a hit slop that makes up 44 pt.

items.name: morph-sheet
items.title: Morph Sheet
items.description: A bottom sheet with snap points that morphs from a floating card into a full sheet and blurs the screen behind.

perf.budget: One shared value (sheet position) drives the morph, scrim, blur intensity and the set-back of the screen; the sheet's insets are laid out on the UI thread while it moves. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The sheet moves with a short timing and the screen behind does not scale.
a11y.screenReader: The open sheet is modal; the screen behind is hidden. Actions: close (also escape), expand and collapse. The scrim is a 'Close sheet' button.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole sheet is draggable; the scrim closes it.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: A number whose digits roll like a mechanical counter, forward or back, the long way round.

perf.budget: One spring per changed digit column on the UI thread; layout transitions only when the number gains or loses columns.

measurements.notes: Frames at rest in the measurement came from the demo changing its value every few seconds; with a fixed value nothing redraws.

a11y.reducedMotion: Digits change in place without rolling; no column transitions.
a11y.screenReader: Exposed as one text element with the formatted value. Set `announce` to read changes aloud (live region).
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: parallax-carousel
items.title: Parallax Carousel
items.description: A paging carousel whose pictures drift inside their cards as they slide, with the centre card brought forward.

perf.budget: One drag offset drives three transforms per card on the UI thread; React renders only when the centre card changes.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cards keep their size and the pictures stay put; cards settle without overshoot.
a11y.screenReader: Each card is an image (or a button when onPress is set) named by its title or accessibilityLabel, with Next card and Previous card actions; the centre card is selected.
a11y.touchTarget: Cards are at least half the carousel's width.

items.name: parallax-header
items.title: Parallax Header
items.description: A scroll view whose header artwork scrolls at half speed, stretches on pull and hands off to a compact bar.

perf.budget: The scroll offset is read on the UI thread; four style worklets (artwork, title, bar, bar title) run per scroll frame. No JS work while scrolling.

a11y.reducedMotion: The artwork scrolls with the content instead of at half speed; titles fade without moving.
a11y.screenReader: The large title is a header; the compact bar's copy of it is hidden to avoid reading it twice. Artwork is decorative.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive itself; barAccessory keeps its own targets.

items.name: press-jelly
items.title: Press Jelly
items.description: A primary button that squashes like jelly under the finger and wobbles back on release.

perf.budget: Two scale springs per press, started on the UI thread; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: A 2% press-in instead of the squash and wobble.
a11y.screenReader: Button role with disabled and busy states; 'activate' presses it.
a11y.touchTarget: 48 pt (md) or 56 pt (lg) tall, at least 96 pt wide.

items.name: pulse-toggle
items.title: Pulse Toggle
items.description: A switch whose thumb stretches mid-flight, lands as a rounded square and pulses when it turns on.

perf.budget: One spring and one 480 ms ring timing per toggle; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Thumb slides with a short timing; no stretch and no pulse ring.
a11y.screenReader: Switch role with checked and disabled states; the visible label is the accessible name.
a11y.touchTarget: Row is at least 44 pt tall; a bare toggle gets an 8 pt hit slop.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A radar chart whose shapes grow from the centre and morph to new values; tap the legend to compare.

perf.budget: The web is built once per size. Each series is one path rebuilt from a handful of points on the UI thread while it grows or morphs, then static.

a11y.reducedMotion: Shapes appear at their values; new values replace the old without morphing.
a11y.screenReader: The chart reads as an image listing every series by axis; legend chips are switches.
a11y.touchTarget: Legend chips are at least 44 pt tall.

items.name: ripple-field
items.title: Ripple Field
items.description: A dot-grid surface that ripples outward from every touch, drawn by a shader.

perf.budget: A full-surface shader runs only for 2.5 s after a touch; at rest the grid is drawn once and nothing runs per frame.

a11y.reducedMotion: A static dot grid; touches do not start ripples.
a11y.screenReader: Decorative: the canvas is hidden from assistive tech. Children stay accessible.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole surface; it never claims the gesture from children or scroll views.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Characters cycle through random glyphs and lock into place from left to right.

perf.budget: Re-renders one Text at ~18 Hz for `duration` ms, then stops. Deliberately not driven per frame through a TextInput: on Android Fabric that chains text-input states and can crash.

measurements.notes: Frames at rest in the measurement came from the demo cycling words; the effect stops once the text settles.

a11y.reducedMotion: Shows the final text immediately.
a11y.screenReader: Exposed as a single text element with the final string; the scrambling glyphs are hidden.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: scroll-stack
items.title: Scroll Stack
items.description: A scroll view whose cards pin to the top and pile up, the ones beneath shrinking and dimming as more land.

perf.budget: One scroll offset drives a transform and an overlay per card on the UI thread; nothing renders while scrolling.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cards still pin and stack, which is how the layout reads, but without shrinking or dimming.
a11y.screenReader: A plain scroll view; cards are read in order and their content keeps its own roles.
a11y.touchTarget: Cards are full width and `cardHeight` tall.

items.name: shine-text
items.title: Shine Text
items.description: A line of text with a band of light sweeping across the glyphs.

perf.budget: Native: one text draw with a moving gradient per frame while sweeping; idle between sweeps. Web: a CSS animation.

measurements.notes: Sweeps by design while active; pass active={false} to stop.

a11y.reducedMotion: Plain text in the base colour, no sheen.
a11y.screenReader: Exposed as a single text element with the full string.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: skeleton-sweep
items.title: Skeleton Sweep
items.description: Loading placeholders with one band of light sweeping across the whole layout.

perf.budget: One repeating timing per group; each block applies a single translate. Pauses when `active` is false.

measurements.notes: Sweeps by design while loading; unmounts with the placeholder.

a11y.reducedMotion: Static placeholders with no sweep.
a11y.screenReader: The group is a busy progress bar with a label ('Loading' by default); individual blocks are hidden.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: slide-confirm
items.title: Slide to Confirm
items.description: Drag the knob across to confirm. A trail follows it, light sweeps the track, and it lands as a check.

perf.budget: The knob follows the finger on the UI thread; the idle sweep is one repeating timing on a transform.

a11y.reducedMotion: No sweeping light; the knob still follows the finger and snaps without overshoot.
a11y.screenReader: A button named by the label; 'activate' confirms without dragging. After confirming it reads the confirmed label.
a11y.touchTarget: The knob is 56 pt; the track is 64 pt tall.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A key figure that counts up, with a change pill and a sparkline that draws itself in.

perf.budget: The sparkline is built once per data change and revealed by a clip on the UI thread; the figure re-renders only while it counts.

a11y.reducedMotion: The figure and the sparkline appear complete.
a11y.screenReader: One summary: label, value, change ('up 12.4%') and caption. A button when onPress is set.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole card when it is pressable.

items.name: status-button
items.title: Status Button
items.description: A button that folds into a spinner while it works, then opens in green with a traced check, or shakes in red.

perf.budget: Width, colour and icon animations are springs and timings on the UI thread; the spinner's frame callback runs only while loading.

a11y.reducedMotion: States switch with a short fade: no width spring, spinning or shake.
a11y.screenReader: Button role; its name follows the state (label, 'in progress', success or error label) and is announced politely. Busy while loading.
a11y.touchTarget: 52 pt tall; at least 52 pt wide while loading.

items.name: story-card
items.title: Story Card
items.description: Full-bleed stories with progress bars: tap to step, hold to pause, each picture drifting closer as it plays.

perf.budget: One timing value drives the bar and the drift on the UI thread; every picture is mounted once and crossfaded, so stepping never waits on a decode.

measurements.notes: Animates by design while a story plays; pass paused off-screen.

a11y.reducedMotion: Pictures switch without the fade or the drift; the bars still fill.
a11y.screenReader: An adjustable element named after the story, valued 'Story 2 of 5'; swipe up or down to step. Stories do not advance on their own while a screen reader runs.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole card: its left third steps back, the rest forward.

items.name: tilt-deck
items.title: Tilt Deck
items.description: A card that tilts in 3D under the finger, with parallax layers and a drifting floor shadow.

perf.budget: Touch moves retarget two springs on the UI thread; each TiltLayer adds one transform. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: No rotation, parallax or lift; the card dips 2% while pressed.
a11y.screenReader: Button role when onPress is set; pass accessibilityLabel to describe the card. Layers are not separately exposed.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole card is the target.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.description: Notifications that stack like cards, fan out on tap and swipe away sideways.

perf.budget: Springs run only while toasts enter, re-stack, expand or leave; swipes track on the UI thread.

a11y.reducedMotion: Toasts fade in and out in place; no slide, scale or fly-out.
a11y.screenReader: Each toast is announced when shown and exposed as an alert with a 'Dismiss' action; the Undo-style action is its own button.
a11y.touchTarget: Action buttons are at least 44 pt tall.

items.name: two-step-button
items.title: Two-Step Button
items.description: A button that asks before it acts: it splits into Cancel and Confirm, and the question closes by itself.

perf.budget: Plain views animated by two shared values: the split and the countdown. No canvas, no work at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The halves appear in place and the countdown band holds still; the question still closes after the timeout.
a11y.screenReader: One button, then two (Cancel, and Confirm with the action's name). Opening the question is announced.
a11y.touchTarget: 52 pt tall; each half spans its share of the full width.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Text typed out with a human rhythm; several phrases are typed, held, erased and replaced in turn.

perf.budget: One timeout per character and a slow caret blink at rest. Plain text, so it wraps and scales like any other.

measurements.notes: Draws while it types, by design. Janky frames come from redrawing the demo card's full-size photo behind each new letter; frame times stay at p50 17 ms, p99 25 ms.

a11y.reducedMotion: Whole phrases appear and swap after each hold; the caret still blinks at rest.
a11y.screenReader: Reads as text with the whole current phrase, never a half-typed one.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: word-cascade
items.title: Word Cascade
items.description: A paragraph that arrives word by word, each word rising into place after the last.

perf.budget: One linear timing drives every word; each word evaluates a small style worklet per frame until the cascade ends.

a11y.reducedMotion: The whole paragraph appears at once.
a11y.screenReader: Exposed as one text element with the full paragraph; individual words are hidden.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: word-rotator
items.title: Word Rotator
items.description: A line with one word that keeps changing, rolling out and in letter by letter while its gap springs to fit.

perf.budget: One clock drives every letter on the UI thread; the width is one spring. Words are measured once, off screen.

measurements.notes: Animates by design while words rotate; pass paused off-screen.

a11y.reducedMotion: Words crossfade in place; the gap still resizes.
a11y.screenReader: Reads the whole line once, with every word in turn, instead of announcing each change.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive.

items.name: onboarding-flow
items.title: Onboarding Flow
items.description: A paged welcome flow: spotlit illustrations that drift with the swipe, story-style progress, a button that grows.

perf.budget: One shader background plus the visible slide. Paging, parallax, the progress bars and the growing button are scroll-driven worklets; nothing runs on the JS thread while swiping.

a11y.reducedMotion: Titles appear without cascading and the background holds still (handled by Word Cascade and Aurora Veil). Paging is user-driven, so it stays.
a11y.screenReader: Only the current slide is exposed. The progress bars read as "Step 2 of 3". The round button is named Continue, then Get started. Skip is hidden on the last slide.
a11y.touchTarget: Skip is at least 44 pt; the round button is 56 pt and spans the width on the last slide.

items.name: paywall
items.title: Paywall
items.description: A subscription screen with a drifting gradient hero, rolling plan prices and confetti on purchase.

perf.budget: One shader hero (scrolls away with the content) and a looping sheen on the title. Price changes roll digits on the UI thread; confetti runs only for ~3 s after a purchase.

a11y.reducedMotion: The hero and title sheen hold still, prices change without rolling and no confetti is drawn (handled by each component).
a11y.screenReader: Plans are a radio group ("Yearly, $39.99 per year, Save 44%, selected"). The monthly price is read as one value. The button announces which plan it buys and its busy state.
a11y.touchTarget: Plan cards are 72 pt tall; close, links and the main button are at least 44 pt.

items.name: player-sheet
items.title: Player Sheet
items.description: A music library whose mini player opens into a full player: tilting cover, elastic scrubber.

perf.budget: Nothing animates while idle. The sheet, cover tilt and scrubber are gesture-driven worklets; the title scramble runs for under a second per track change. The stand-in clock updates once a second and is replaced by your player's position.

a11y.reducedMotion: The sheet opens with a short fade, the cover does not tilt, the title changes without scrambling and the scrubber does not stretch (handled by each component).
a11y.screenReader: Tracks are buttons with title, artist and length; the current one is marked selected. The mini player reads "Now playing" and opens the player. The sheet is modal with an escape action; the scrubber is adjustable and reads the time.
a11y.touchTarget: Rows are 64 pt; play, previous, next and the mini player button are at least 44 pt.

items.name: profile-hero
items.title: Profile Hero
items.description: A profile screen: parallax cover, follow button with a rolling count, liquid tabs and loading skeletons.

perf.budget: The cover shader runs while the header is on screen; the parallax, collapsing bar and tab indicator are scroll- and spring-driven worklets. The grid is plain views.

a11y.reducedMotion: The cover holds still, the header scrolls without parallax, counts change without rolling and skeletons do not sweep (handled by each component).
a11y.screenReader: The name is a header; each stat reads as one value ("24,817 followers"); tabs are a tab list; skeletons announce "Loading posts". Following shows a toast with an Undo action.
a11y.touchTarget: Buttons and tabs are at least 44 pt.
